title.narrative: Transforming wildlife conservation and livelihoods at the landscape scale in Mozambique (TRANSFORM)

description.narrative: The objective of the GEF PPG is to develop the project concept into a full project: Mozambique Wildlife Conservation for Development Integrated Program . As described in the project concept (PIF/child project concept note), this project will focus on the Rovuma-Lugenda Landscape in the northern part and the Gorongosa-Marromeu Landscape in the central part of Mozambique. It will contribute to landscape integrity and connectivity and diversification of sustainable livelihoods, through establishing wildlife corridors and by developing integrated land use planning instruments creating enabling conditions for the structuration of community settlements and respective socio-economic activities. This will be accompanied by combatting illegal wildlife trade and poaching as well as implementation of tailored strategies for the mitigation of human-wildlife conflict. It will also address the risk of disease transmission between wild fauna, domestic fauna and potentially humans. Policy and legislation will be revised to provide an aligned governance framework ensuring the scaling of WCD beyond the proposed project scope and duration, strengthening also transboundary collaboration with neighboring countries including Tanzania, Zimbabwe and South Africa on issues of illegal wildlife trafficking. Learning centers for biodiversity conservation and sustainable management of natural resources, which will be designed as on-the-ground community learning experiences, will be established with local communities and scientific institutions to support knowledge retention and sharing, dissemination of best practices, community awareness and development of local skills.
